name: LingBot-Map
plain: LingBot-Map (Robbyant, 2026): streaming 3D reconstruction, cameras and depth for a long image sequence frame by frame with a sliding-window cache. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: LingBot-Map (Robbyant, 2026): streaming 3D reconstruction. A VGGT-style aggregator (DINOv2 ViT-L patch embed, 24 frame / global attention blocks, 3D RoPE) runs causally over the views in order with a KV cache (scale frames + a sliding window), then a camera head and a DPT depth head give cameras and depth of every view.

papers.title: LingBot-Map: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

limitations: Views are a sequence (a video): each view only sees the first `scale_frames` views and the views before it (older than `window` frames: their 6 special tokens only). At most 1024 views.
task_io: Input: several images of one scene (posed and calibrated for multi-view stereo, unposed otherwise). Output: depth maps and, where the model predicts them, cameras and 3-D points.

variants.name: lingbot-map

licence.training_note: Per the README: a stage-1 bidirectional (VGGT-style) checkpoint, then streaming training; datasets are not listed

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

input.name: motorcycle
input.title: Motorcycle, Middlebury 2014 stereo (left and right view, downscaled 4x)

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `depth`).
